title: 谷歌 CEO 如何向员工解释混合办公安排（2021）
topic: 谷歌 CEO 如何向员工解释混合办公安排（2021）

source.title: A hybrid approach to work
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文为 Sundar Pichai 于 2021 年 5 月 5 日发布的员工邮件；本课只呈现其中完整的 “A more flexible work week” 小节，安排按历史提案表述。
paragraphs: We’ll move to a hybrid work week where most Googlers spend approximately three days in the office and two days wherever they work best.
Since in-office time will be focused on collaboration, your product areas and functions will help decide which days teams will come together in the office.
There will also be roles that may need to be on site more than three days a week due to the nature of the work.
translations: 我们将转向混合办公周：大多数 Google 员工每周大约三天在办公室工作，两天在最适合自己的地点工作。
由于到办公室的时间将主要用于协作，各产品和职能部门将帮助决定团队每周哪几天一起到办公室。
也有一些岗位可能因工作性质需要每周在现场工作超过三天。
fullTextParagraphs: We’ll move to a hybrid work week where most Googlers spend approximately three days in the office and two days wherever they work best.
Since in-office time will be focused on collaboration, your product areas and functions will help decide which days teams will come together in the office.
There will also be roles that may need to be on site more than three days a week due to the nature of the work.

notes.phrase: approximately three days in the office
notes.meaning: 每周大约三天在办公室
notes.explain: approximately 表示“大约”；most 也说明这是多数员工的安排，不能改写成所有人都一样。
notes.example: Most employees would spend approximately three days in the office.

notes.meaning: 在最适合他们工作的地点
notes.explain: wherever 引导地点从句，强调地点选择；原邮件没有把它限定为只能在家。
notes.example: On remote days, people can work wherever they work best.

notes.explain: focused on 后接名词，说明到办公室的时间主要用来做什么。
notes.example: The planning session will be focused on collaboration.

notes.phrase: will help decide which days teams will come together
notes.meaning: 将协助决定团队哪几天共同到办公室
notes.explain: help decide 后面接决定内容；原文说产品和职能部门会参与，不是团队各自随意安排。
notes.example: The department will help decide which days the team comes in.

notes.phrase: on site more than three days a week
notes.meaning: 每周在工作现场超过三天
notes.explain: on site 指在工作场所或指定现场；原文把这作为某些岗位可能的例外。
notes.example: Some support roles may need to be on site more often.

scenario.title: Summarizing Google’s 2021 hybrid-work proposal
english: A teammate asks what Google proposed in its May 2021 hybrid-work email.
The email described an approximate three-day office week for most employees, with two days at the place where they worked best.
Product areas and functions would help decide shared office days, and some roles could require more on-site time.
chinese: 一位同事问 Google 在 2021 年 5 月的混合办公邮件中提出了什么安排。
邮件提出，多数员工每周大约三天在办公室、两天在最适合自己的地点工作。
产品和职能部门会协助决定共同到岗日，部分岗位可能需要更多现场办公时间。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事问 Google 2021 年邮件提出的混合办公周如何安排。请用 2–3 句概括多数员工的办公室和其他地点工作时间、到岗日由谁协助决定，并说明岗位安排可能不同。
firstAttempt.sample: The May 2021 email said most Googlers would spend approximately three days in the office and two days wherever they worked best. Their product areas and functions would help decide which days teams came together. Some roles might need more than three days on site.
firstAttempt.rationale: 明确这是 2021 年的历史提案，保留“大多数”“大约”和岗位例外，避免把它讲成当前或适用于所有人的统一规则。

words.example: The email proposed a hybrid work week for most employees.
words.translation: 这封邮件为大多数员工提出了混合办公周安排。
words.note: 此处指结合办公室工作和其他地点工作的安排。

words.example: Most Googlers would spend approximately three days in the office.
words.translation: 大多数 Google 员工每周大约三天在办公室工作。
words.note: 用于表达估算值，不表示精确到固定天数。

words.meaning: 无论在哪里；在任何适合的地点
words.example: Employees could work wherever they worked best on other days.
words.translation: 其他工作日，员工可以在最适合自己的地点工作。
words.note: 这里引导地点从句；具体范围仍受岗位和团队需要影响。

words.example: In-office time would be focused on collaboration.
words.translation: 到办公室的时间将以协作为重点。
words.note: 常用于说明团队成员共同推进工作的方式。

words.meaning: 在工作现场；在办公地点
words.example: Some roles may need to be on site more than three days a week.
words.translation: 有些岗位可能每周需要在现场工作超过三天。
words.note: 此处作地点状语；作复合形容词时常写作 on-site。

words.collocation: the nature of the work / some roles
words.example: Some roles may need more time on site because of the nature of the work.
words.translation: 有些岗位可能因工作性质需要更多现场办公时间。
words.note: 在此指工作岗位，不是某人在某个场景里扮演的角色。

structure.original: Since in-office time will be focused on collaboration, your product areas and functions will help decide which days teams will come together in the office.
analysis: Since 引导原因状语从句，说明为什么由相关部门协助决定到岗日期。
in-office time will be focused on collaboration 是一般将来时的被动结构，说明未来办公室时间的用途。
your product areas and functions will help decide 是主句，说明哪些部门会参与决定。
which days teams will come together in the office 是 decide 的宾语从句，说明需要决定的内容。
structure.transfer: The project leads will help decide which days the client team will meet in person.

rewrite.bad: All employees had to come in five days a week, and teams could not choose their schedule.
rewrite.good: The May 2021 email said most Googlers would spend approximately three days in the office and two days wherever they worked best. Product areas and functions would help decide shared office days, although some roles could require more on-site time.
rewrite.translation: 2021 年 5 月的邮件称，大多数 Google 员工每周大约三天在办公室、两天在最适合自己的地点工作。产品和职能部门会协助决定共同到岗日，但有些岗位可能需要更多现场办公时间。
rewrite.pattern: The [dated message] said most people would spend approximately [time] in [place] and work wherever they worked best for the rest. [Relevant groups] would help decide [shared schedule], although some roles could [exception].

cloze.prompt: The May 2021 email said most Googlers would spend ___ three days in the office.
cloze.why: approximately 表示“大约”，保留原提案的估算语气。

cloze.prompt: They would spend two days wherever they worked ___.
cloze.why: where they worked best 指最适合他们工作的地点。

cloze.prompt: Product areas and functions would ___ decide which days teams came together.
cloze.why: 原文说相关部门会协助决定共同到岗日。

dictation.text: We’ll move to a hybrid work week where most Googlers spend approximately three days in the office and two days wherever they work best.
Since in-office time will be focused on collaboration, your product areas and functions will help decide which days teams will come together in the office.

apply.prompt: 一家客户公司正在讨论混合办公提案：大多数员工每周约两天到办公室，其余时间可在适合自己的地点工作；部门会共同确定到岗日。请用英文转述，并说清这是正在讨论的提案。
apply.sample: The proposal would have most employees spend approximately two days in the office and work wherever they work best for the rest. Their departments would help decide which days teams came in, but the plan is still under discussion.

translationPractice.prompt: 2021 年 5 月的邮件称，大多数 Google 员工每周大约三天在办公室工作。
translationPractice.answer: The May 2021 email said most Googlers would spend approximately three days in the office.
translationPractice.why: said 和 would 表示这是当时邮件提出的历史安排。

translationPractice.prompt: 邮件称，他们会有两天在最适合自己的地点工作。
translationPractice.answer: It said they would spend two days wherever they worked best.
translationPractice.why: wherever 引导地点从句，不把工作地点误解为只能在家。

translationPractice.prompt: 他们所在的产品和职能部门会协助决定团队共同到办公室的日期。
translationPractice.answer: Their product areas and functions would help decide which days teams came together.
translationPractice.why: 明确说明相关部门会参与决定，而非所有员工各自选择日期。

choice.prompt: 请选择对 Google 2021 年混合办公邮件准确、且没有把历史提案说成统一现行规则的概括。
options: All Googlers had to work in the office five days a week, and all roles had the same schedule.

The May 2021 email said most Googlers would spend approximately three days in the office and two days wherever they worked best. Product areas and functions would help decide shared office days, although some roles could need more on-site time.
Google promised every employee could work remotely from any country with no approval or role-based conditions.
choice.why: 第二项保留历史时间、多数员工、大约天数、部门参与和岗位例外；另外两项把安排绝对化或添加原文没有的承诺。

output.prompt: 一家客户公司正在讨论新的混合办公提案：多数员工每周约两天到办公室，其余时间在最适合自己的地点工作；项目部门会协助决定共同到岗日，但某些岗位可能需要更多现场时间。请向新同事概括这项提案，并说明它尚未最终确定。
output.sample: The proposal would have most employees spend approximately two days in the office and work wherever they work best for the rest. Project teams would help decide which days to come in, although some roles might need more on-site time. The plan has not been finalized yet.
check: 是否把安排说成提案而非已定规则？
是否说明大多数员工的办公室和其他地点工作时间？
是否说明谁协助决定共同到岗日？
是否保留某些岗位的现场例外？
